source_annotation.prompt: Move the tennis ball into a clear plastic box

generation_prompt: The robot's hand entering from the lower-right edge reaches out, closes its thumb and fingers around the yellow tape measure on the red tabletop, and lifts it. It carries the tape measure to the black metal dish rack, lowers it onto the rack's bars, opens its fingers to release it, then withdraws toward the lower right, leaving the tape measure resting on the rack. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
